description: Convert money between ISO 4217 currencies with daily exchange rates. ECB reference rates (via Frankfurter) are used for USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, AUD, CNY, INR, CZK, HUF, ILS, ISK, RON, BRL, MXN, SGD, HKD, NZD, SEK, NOK, DKK, ZAR, TRY, KRW, THB, MYR, IDR, PHP, PLN; other codes such as PKR, AED, SAR or NGN use the free fawazahmed0 currency API. The result says which source answered. Supports historical dates (YYYY-MM-DD).

date.description: Historical date; omit for the latest rates.

name: convert_currency

source.description: ecb: European Central Bank via Frankfurter. fawazahmed0: wider daily rates for other codes.

title: Convert an amount between currencies
